description_en: Deletes a specified HiMarket developer portal by portal ID
description_zh: 按门户 ID 删除指定的 HiMarket 开发者门户
name: DeletePortal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the portal to delete. You can obtain the portal ID from the portalId field in the CreatePortal response or from the portalId field of an item in the ListPortals response. This parameter uses the same /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} path as the GetPortal, UpdatePortal, and DeletePortal operations to locate the portal
parameters.help_zh: 门户 ID，指定要删除的门户。可由 CreatePortal 响应的 portalId 或 ListPortals 列表项的 portalId 获得，与 GetPortal、UpdatePortal、DeletePortal 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} 路径来定位门户
parameters.name: portal_id
